from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's 10-Q report for the specified period."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company reported in this document")
    reporting_period_ended: str = Field(description="End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    
    net_income_current_period: str = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount for the current quarter")
    net_income_prior_period: str = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount for the same quarter in the prior year")
    
    cash_balance_current_period: str = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at end of current period")
    cash_balance_prior_period: str = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at end of prior period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all financial snapshots from the processed documents."""
    company_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
